module: Import for the Assembly Spline tool: converts TSStatic objects already placed in the level (compatible with the assembly kit, i.e. having anchors named 'nail.*') into an assembly spline. It rebuilds the assembly kit and the molecule from the meshes, fits a polyline on the root components (fitPoly), creates the spline, deletes the original TSStatics (and empty groups) and records the action in the undo history (undo/redo restores the saved TSStatics). Used by the scene tree right-click menu and by the tool's selection polygon.
notes: A TSStatic is compatible if it has at least one anchor whose name starts with "nail.".
At least 2 compatible TSStatics are required, and at least 2 root components that can be fitted to a polyline, otherwise a warning is logged (logtag assemblySpline.import) and nothing is converted.
Variations are recognized by the file name containing "var" and of the form <base>_var...; the base name is rebuilt with the .dae extension.
After the import the spline is marked dirty 2 frames later (handleDelayedSplineUpdates) because it must wait for the collision mesh update.

handleDelayedSplineUpdates.desc: Deferred update after an import: after 2 calls, marks the last assembly spline as dirty to rebuild it once the collision is updated. Called every frame by onEditorGui of assemblySpline.

validateToolCompatibleTSStatic.desc: Indicates whether the object is a TSStatic with at least one anchor whose name starts with "nail.".

convertTSStatics2AssemblySpline.desc: Converts a selection of TSStatics into an assembly spline: filters the compatible ones, rebuilds the kit and the molecule, fits the polyline, creates the spline, deletes the original objects, reloads collision (be:reloadCollision) and records the action "Convert TSStatics to Assembly Spline" in editor.history.

collection.desc: Ids of the selected TSStatic objects.

importFromPolygon.desc: Finds all TSStatics in the level whose position is inside the polygon and converts them via convertTSStatics2AssemblySpline.
